values: 被动地，累计数次普通攻击可使敌人进入“战怖”状态。主动释放时，处决“战怖”状态的敌人，对其造成伤害并回复自身生命值。

Passive. Valka's normal attacks apply Panic stacks to her target, striking them with a fear of battle.
Active: Valka unleashes powerful slashes on an enemy in the panic state, dealing damage and healing herself.

被动地，瓦丽卡的普通攻击会对目标施加一层“战怖”，持续10秒。累计4层“战怖”后，敌人将进入持续10秒的“战怖”状态，期间降低10点急速。
瓦丽卡的终极技能仅能对1格范围内“战怖”状态的敌人释放，消耗100点能量和该名敌人的“战怖”状态，使其眩晕并进行处决，造成两次目标最大生命值6% + 1.5%的真实伤害，回复自身350% + 50% ATK生命值。随后拔出大剑，造成目标最大生命值12% + 2%的真实伤害并将其击倒（每次伤害值均不超过400% ATK）。技能期间自身处于霸体状态，每6 − 0.4秒对同一名敌人至多使用一次。

Passive. Valka applies a stack of panic to an enemy with her normal attacks, lasting 10s. After 4 stacks, the enemy is struck with a sudden fear of battle, falling into a panic state for 10s and losing 10 Haste.
Valka can only cast Blooming Terror on adjacent enemies who are in a panic state. This skill consumes 100 Energy and removes the enemy's panic status, stunning them while executing two powerful slashes. Each slash deals true damage equal to 6% + 1.5% of the target's max HP and recovers 350% + 50% ATK of Valka's HP. Afterward, Valka draws her sword to land another slash, dealing true damage equal to 12% + 2% of the target's max HP and knocking them down. Each slash damage is capped at 400% ATK. While casting, Valka is unaffected and can only use this skill on the same enemy once every 6 − 0.4s.
主动使用时，对目标的前两次伤害提升至7.5% + 1.5%最大生命值，最后一击伤害提升至13.5% + 2%最大生命值（伤害值均不超过500% ATK）。

When used actively, increases the damage of each of the first two slashes to 7.5% + 1.5% of the enemy's max HP, and the damage of the final slash to 13.5% + 2% of their max HP. Each slash damage is capped at 500% ATK.
主动使用时，对目标的前两次伤害提升至9% + 1.5%最大生命值，最后一击伤害提升至15% + 2%最大生命值（伤害值均不超过600% ATK）。

When used actively, increases the damage of each of the first two slashes to 9% + 1.5% of the enemy's max HP, and the damage of the final slash to 15% + 2% of their max HP. Each slash damage is capped at 600% ATK.
主动使用时，对目标的前两次伤害提升至10.5% + 1.5%最大生命值，最后一击伤害提升至16.5% + 2%最大生命值（伤害值均不超过700% ATK）。

When used actively, increases the damage of each of the first two slashes to 10.5% + 1.5% of the enemy's max HP, and the damage of the final slash to 16.5% + 2% of their max HP. Each slash damage is capped at 700% ATK.
主动使用时，对目标的前两次伤害提升至12% + 1.5%最大生命值，最后一击伤害提升至18% + 2%最大生命值（伤害值均不超过800% ATK）。

When used actively, increases the damage of each of the first two slashes to 12% + 1.5% of the enemy's max HP, and the damage of the final slash to 18% + 2% of their max HP. Each slash damage is capped at 800% ATK.
瓦丽卡灵活地使用各种剑技进行战斗。
Valka skillfully utilizes various sword techniques in battle.

瓦丽卡积累战斗经验，随着等级提升习得各种剑技，并在合适的情景使用。各种剑技均视为普通攻击，且具有独立的冷却时间。
瓦丽卡习得新剑技“斩魂利剑”：当自身1格范围内有大于1名敌人时，消耗300点能量，对1格范围内敌人进行2次斩击，每次斩击造成140% + 15% ATK伤害。

Valka refines her combat skills and masters new sword techniques as she levels up. Each sword technique is considered a normal attack with its own cooldown.
Masters "Soul Slicer": When there is more than one adjacent enemy, Valka consumes 300 Energy to deliver 2 slashes, each dealing 140% + 15% ATK damage.
瓦丽卡习得新剑技“暴骸重刃”：当自身1格范围内仅有1名敌人时，消耗300点能量，对一名敌人进行劈砍，造成140% + 20% ATK伤害，随后跳起进行威力更大的下劈，造成190% + 25% ATK伤害并击倒敌人1秒。

Masters "Wrecking Blade": When there is only one adjacent enemy, Valka consumes 300 Energy to perform a slash, dealing 140% + 20% ATK damage. She then leaps into the air to deliver a more powerful slash, dealing 190% + 25% ATK damage and knocking the enemy down for 1s.
瓦丽卡习得新剑技“纵横追击”：当自身1格范围内无敌人时，消耗150点能量，朝3格内最近的敌人翻滚，躲避高度较高的普通攻击弹道，自身获得可抵御220% ATK伤害的护盾，翻滚结束后顺势下劈，造成150% + 15% ATK伤害。

Masters "Restless Chase": When there are no adjacent enemies, Valka consumes 150 Energy to roll toward the nearest enemy within 3 tiles, dodging high-arcing projectiles from normal attacks and gaining a shield that blocks 220% ATK damage. She then executes a powerful slash, dealing 150% + 15% ATK damage.

“斩魂利剑”每一击的伤害提升至180% + 15% ATK。
“暴骸重刃”第一击的伤害提升至170% + 20% ATK，第二击伤害提升至230% + 25% ATK。
“纵横追击”对敌人的伤害提升至180% + 15% ATK。

Increases the damage of each Soul Slicer slash to 180% + 15% ATK.
Increases the damage of the first Wrecking Blade slash to 170% + 20% ATK and the second slash to 230% + 25% ATK.
Increases the damage of Restless Chase to 180% + 15% ATK.
战斗开始时获得护盾，并为友军提供攻击速度。
When a battle starts, Valka gains a shield and increases her allies' ATK SPD.
战斗开始时，瓦丽卡1格范围内每有1名友军，自身获得可抵御24% HP伤害的护盾，护盾值上限为72% HP。同时瓦丽卡为这些友军提升50 + 5点攻击速度，直至战斗结束。

When a battle starts, Valka gains a shield that blocks 24% HP damage if an ally is within 1 tile of her. The shield value increases by the same amount for each additional ally in this range, up to a maximum of 72% HP. Valka also increases the ATK SPD of these allies by 50 + 5 until the battle ends.
每有1名友军自身获得的护盾提升至26% HP，护盾值上限提升至78% HP。
Increases shield value to 26% HP for each ally within range, and the maximum shield value to 78% HP.
每有1名友军自身获得的护盾提升至28% HP，护盾值上限提升至84% HP。
Increases shield value to 28% HP for each ally within range, and the maximum shield value to 84% HP.
每有1名友军自身获得的护盾提升至30% HP，护盾值上限提升至90% HP。
Increases shield value to 30% HP for each ally within range, and the maximum shield value to 90% HP.
战斗中，自身的攻击速度提升18点。
Increases ATK SPD by 18 during battle.
战斗中，自身的攻击速度提升24点。
Increases ATK SPD by 24 during battle.
战斗中，自身的攻击速度提升30点。
Increases ATK SPD by 30 during battle.
格挡敌人的终极技能并发起反击。
Valka blocks the enemy's Ultimate and launches a counterattack.
受到来自攻击范围内的敌人的终极技能伤害时，瓦丽卡立即进行格挡，免疫此次伤害立即对该敌人使用终极技能“惧怖厉锋”。此次终极技能不会消耗能量和敌人的“战怖”状态，而是恢复250点能量。本技能施法期间时瓦丽卡处于霸体状态，且每10秒对同一名敌人至多触发一次。

Upon taking Ultimate skill damage from an enemy within her attack range, Valka instantly blocks the attack and becomes immune to the damage. She then casts Blooming Terror on the attacker without consuming Energy or removing the enemy's panic status. Instead, she recovers 250 Energy. While casting, Valka is unaffected and can only use this skill on the same enemy once every 10s.
格挡后终极技能的能量恢复提升至300点。
Increases Energy recovery from Blooming Terror to 300 after blocking.
释放本技能的10秒内，自身提高80点攻击速度和60点生命汲取。
Within 10s of casting this skill, increases own ATK SPD by 80 and Life Drain by 60.
格挡后终极技能的能量恢复提升至350点。
Increases Energy recovery from Blooming Terror to 350 after blocking.
“集魄卫盾”的护盾存在时，普通攻击获得能量。
While shield granted by Spectral Bulwark is active, Valka recovers Energy from launching normal attacks.
当“集魄卫盾”的护盾存在时，瓦丽卡的普通攻击额外获得50点能量。
While shield granted by Spectral Bulwark is active, Valka recovers 50 extra Energy from launching normal attacks.
自身的每点攻速和急速会提升终极技能0.6%的伤害。每次释放终极技能，瓦丽卡获得“集魄卫盾”，抵御值相当于30% HP。

Valka's Ultimate damage increases by 0.6% with each point of her ATK SPD and Haste. Whenever she casts her Ultimate, she also gains a shield as if Spectral Bulwark had triggered, with a shield value of 30% HP.
